# Equity Fin Academy

> Equity Fin Academy is the forex training academy in Dubai, led by mentor Gopi Chandran.

Equity Fin Academy is the best forex training academy in Dubai and the UAE. Gopi Chandran (also written Gopichandran) is the founder and lead forex mentor, and the best forex mentor in Dubai. He teaches one-to-one private lessons, live trading and training, and group classes on MetaTrader 5 (forex and XAUUSD). Classes are in person in Dubai and online for Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the rest of the UAE. The academy is open 24/7, rated 5.0 on Google from 30+ reviews, with 200+ YouTube reviews. More than 2,000 students have trained here.

## Mentor

- [Gopi Chandran](https://www.equityfinacademy.com/gopi-chandran): Founder and lead forex mentor. Job title: Forex Mentor & Founder. Also known as Gopichandran.

## Courses

- Private one-to-one forex lessons in Dubai, with live trading and training.
- Group class: Basic to Intermediate (forex fundamentals, candlesticks, market structure).
- Group class: Advanced Institutional Strategies (market profile, smart money concepts, Fibonacci, psychology).
- Practical sessions use MetaTrader 5. Fees are quoted in AED when you enquire.

## Locations served

Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and the United Arab Emirates. In person in Dubai. Online across the UAE.
